about: Each event's own cover image (the og:image its organiser set on the public Luma page), kept in a covers vault with a public read key (data/capture-vaults.json). Pointers only: vault id, path, sha256, source URL, captured_at. Credit: 'image: <organiser>'. Covers only, never a guest list or a host's face from the page body (work/45). Held by the lead at 16:23 UTC: Luma's Terms of Use (6 October 2026) prohibit 'downloading, republication ... of any image ... as a stand-alone file', so no Luma image is shown or kept (work/49).

images.organiser: Taiga AI Oy, Finland (as the page names it: 'an independent project by Taiga AI Oy', not affiliated with Web Summit)
